title: CloneWarsFR
description: Plongez dans la Guerre des Clones et forgez votre propre destin ! Créez un personnage unique et participez à des batailles épiques, des intrigues captivantes et des missions palpitantes. Ici, on ne suit pas forcément le lore à 100% : laissez libre cours à votre créativité, inventez votre propre histoire et vivez une aventure RP sans limites. Unissez vos forces et laissez votre empreinte sur l’histoire galactique ! discord.gg/clonewarsfr

title: RecCenterITALIANO
description: Benvenuto nel primo e più famoso Rec Center italiano al mondo!✨ Esplora un centro unico dove puoi divertirti con tavoli da disegno, giochi e molto altro! Unisciti alla community e scopri un luogo ricco di attività e divertimento. Per assistenza e molto altro, entra nel nostro Discord: https://discord.gg/CRzqSP9Zp4. -Mappa creata da Marte e Fidex

title: KingdomTycoonSim
description: Inspired by Clash of Clans, build and upgrade buildings in your own personal village! Then, take up arms to raid other players and defend your kingdom!

title: CriticalResponse
description: Tackle wacky AI-powered 911 calls ranging from accidental cat burglars to alien abductions gone wrong. Stay cool, make absurdly strategic choices, and dispatch your crew. Can you keep the city standing... or at least vaguely intact? The hotline is ringing! Join Now! Recent Updates: • Added a prompt to buy a discounted energy pack when you need it most. • New players now get their first call immediately. • New players now get 100 energy to start off with. • The server now won't break for new players.

title: RunTheBlock
description: 3–2–1–GO!!! Run, jump, and race your friends in RUN THE BLOCK, the coolest parkour festival in Rec City! Upgrade your abilities, complete Challenges, and compete in Public Events to reach S Rank and become Top Dawg!

title: MyLittleMonsters
description: Your Monster Caretaking Adventure Awaits! -------------------------- New Update! Monsters! Now with Personality! * A tree fell in downtown Cryptid Creek! What are those mushrooms doing there? * Monsters in Cryptid Creek feel much livelier. Look at how cute they are when they're interacting with one another! * Have you always wanted to bounce on those umbrellas? We sure have. Go for it! * Take a seat downtown and hang out with your friends and monsters!
